summary.title: Adapting to Endure 2022
summary.one_liner: A Sequoia Capital digital toolkit of four founder presentations on navigating the 2022 market downturn, covering scenario planning, extending runway, and leading through uncertainty.
takeaways: The toolkit consists of four presentations hosted for Sequoia founders between May 16 and June 3, 2022.
Forecasting & Scenario Planning covers how to model possible futures for a startup.
Extending Your Runway addresses stretching cash reserves during tough markets.
Leading in Uncertain Times focuses on leadership practices during economic uncertainty.
summary.summary: This Sequoia Capital page shares a digital toolkit built from a series of sessions held for founders from May 16 to June 3, 2022. The stated aim is to help startups navigate the market conditions of that period and emerge as strong, enduring companies. The page lists four presentations: "Adapting to Endure" (Ravi Gupta and Pat Grady), "Forecasting & Scenario Planning" (Gupta and Grady), "Extending Your Runway" (Gupta and Sonya Huang), and "Leading in Uncertain Times" (Carl Eschenbach and Jess Lee). The page itself contains only titles and links, so the detailed content lives in the linked presentations.
